proposed_wording_by_destination.status: Draft destinationscope wording only; finalrelay/clientbehaviorandretention mustbe approved beforetranslation
proposed_wording_by_destination.public_automatic: Automatic public reports send a limited technical error summary to the spaCR reporting service. It can create or update an issue on the public spaCR GitHub repository. The summary excludes raw logs, settings, file paths and personal text. Public issues can be indexed and copied and cannot be reliably unpublished. You can turn automatic reports off in Preferences.
proposed_wording_by_destination.public_manual: Review the exact issue title and body before sending. Anything you add may be public, including personal information or secrets. Review again after edits or diagnosis changes. Cancelling prevents this public submission; it does not undo an earlier cloud diagnosis request.
proposed_wording_by_destination.cloud_error: Cloud diagnosis sends a limited technical error summary through the spaCR service to its cloud AI provider. It does not require a public GitHub issue or your own AI account. Network services receive connection metadata. The answer is generated advice; it is not a verified diagnosis and no command is run automatically. You can disable cloud diagnosis separately.
proposed_wording_by_destination.cloud_chat: Using hosted chat sends the question and any conversation context explicitly included for this request to the cloud service. That text may contain personal or confidential information. Review what is sent. Prior CLI conversations, raw logs and settings are not transferred automatically.
proposed_wording_by_destination.local_bundle: A local crash-report ZIP can contain absolute paths, raw logs, settings, run identifiers and exception details. It is not an anonymous report. Inspect it before attaching or sharing it; it is not uploaded automatically.
proposed_wording_by_destination.retention_scope: Guide citesCloudflare statedno-trainingwithoutconsent policy; this reviewdoesnotindependentlyverifycurrentvendorpolicy orclaimzerooperationalretention. Finalnotice mustidentifyactualprovider/relay, applicablepolicy, localqueue/servercounter/IP retention anddeletewindow actuallyimplemented. Do nottranslatefuturecaps/modelquality/freequota asmeasureddeployedfacts.
proposed_wording_by_destination.fairness_ids: If needed, keep optionalpseudonymousinstall/challenge/IPquota data separatefrompublictechnicalpayload, discloseitsuse, boundretention, neverclaimanonymousauthentication orpublishit.
proposed_wording_by_destination.existing_cli: Existing CLI uses selected user-owned coding-agent CLI and account/configuration. Raw error/context may be handed to CLI; deployment/transport/billing vary. Preserve correct install/login instructions; not all CLIs are remote/account-free.
proposed_wording_by_destination.local_log_excerpt: Current preference can save a standalone locally redacted recent-log artifact and name it; log itself is not automatically attached to GitHub. Inspect before manual sharing. Distinct from sensitive raw crash-report ZIP; not guarantee all secrets/personal data removed.
proposed_wording_by_destination.legacy_expanded_public_body: Current expanded body can include arbitrary traceback/settings/advice. Future strict automatic route must omit/restructure into approved typed summary. Manual expanded content requires exact safe preview and explicit review.
